notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Prospect: DoD-affiliated national ops center; highly regulated.
- Want fully air-gapped private deployment; cannot allow outbound model telemetry.
- Key ask: model weights stored on-prem, no external model pull, local KMS + FIPS HSM for keys.
- Quote from CISO: 'We need cryptographic proof and a closed execution envelope — nothing unexpected leaves the facility.'
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — will trade up for certified controls and predictable ops.
- Throughput target: sustained 60 qps for short command prompts, peak burst to 200 qps during exercises.
- Latency SLO: 100-250ms p50 for short prompt path is ideal; can accept higher for long-context batch jobs.
- Models: open to 7B-70B optimized weights; prefer quantized variants that support FMA-free kernels; require model provenance and bill of materials.
- Routing/fallback: require deterministic offline fallback plan; if primary model offline, must failover to pinned smaller model locally in same air-gapped environment.
- Observability: need local logging, STIG-compliant audit trails, and exportable tamper-evident logs for yearly audits.
- Data retention: strict retention windows + legal hold capabilities.
- Integration: SSO via SAML to government IdP; SCIM not in initial scope.
- Recent ask: provide a sample SCC + Network topology diagram, and a runbook for secure model updates.
- POC constraints: no external GitHub, bring-your-own-media for software images; validation team must be able to checksum and freeze images.
- Next: deliver SOW draft + SCC by 2026-03-20; runbook & HSM architecture by 2026-04-01.
- Internal: legal already looped (G. Patel), security reviewer (R. Lawson).
- Sales note: long procurement cycle (6-9 months) expected; high likelihood if HSM + STIG evidence provided.
use_case_summary: Primary use: classified/controlled AI assistants and document processing inside air-gapped datacenter. Need secure inference lifecycle: model onboarding, cryptographically-verified updates, local embeddings for search, and fast, low-latency chat for ops staff.
